source: Regulation C publication rules as they present in the FFIEC 2024 public file. The Filing Instructions Guide itself has not been read from the primary document; however, every granularity claim below is now checked against a retrieved file rather than asserted.

verification.method: Checked against all 400 records of the retrieved 2024 slice for LEI 549300MGPZBLQDIL7538, county 06073.
verification.loan_amount: loan_amount mod 10000 == 5000 for every record, with no exceptions. Bin midpoint at $10,000 confirmed.
verification.property_value: property_value mod 10000 == 5000 for every record. Bin midpoint at $10,000 confirmed.
verification.income: income mod 1000 == 0 for every record. Rounding to $1,000 confirmed. Note the public field is expressed in thousands and is scaled at ingest.
verification.combined_loan_to_value_ratio: Reported to three decimal places (e.g. 99.522, 67.755). Reported, not derived, confirmed.
verification.debt_to_income_ratio: Every numeric value falls in [36, 49] inclusive; all other records carry a band string that normalises to null. The integer region and the bucket width outside it are confirmed.
verification.not_verified: The 2024 slice contains no EGRRCPA partial-exemption records, so the 'Exempt' sentinel path is exercised only by the synthetic fixture and by unit tests, not by this file.
